(1) the textual patterns learned from the TREC QA data are very effective to answer a wide variety of questions, (2) the support and confidence measures are useful to assess the quality of the textual patterns learned.
(1) The Web can be used to automatically learn a lot of textual question-answer patterns for different kinds of questions.
the proposed approach to question answering is a viable alternative to the current methods, and that this approach is a promising direction of research.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following two aspects: (1) How to learn the textual patterns for each type of questions from the Web automatically? (2) How to utilize these textual patterns to extract and rank plausible answers on the World Wide Web?
two issues: (1) how to learn textual patterns from the Web automatically and (2) how to use textual patterns in question answering.
